title_en: In Myslym Shyr, Behind Pjeter Budi School, 1+1 Fully Invested Apartment For Sale!!
description_en: In Myslym Shyr, behind the Pjeter Budi School, 1+1 fully invested apartment for sale. The apartment is located on the third floor of one of the existing 5-storey buildings with a net area of ​​42 m2 and is organized by the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen corner, a room with access to the balcony, a toilet and a balcony. The apartment is completely invested from scratch, starting with new electrical and plumbing installations, parquet, double-glazed plastic windows, internal and external doors. Also, this apartment is a very good opportunity both for housing and for investment, since the rent requirements are very high. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
